page.overview:
Who is Agztash Splitknuckle?

is one of the local representatives of the Revolutionary Council of Dol-Makjar. He occupies the seat reserved for the orcish Wall Clan and was a legendary hero of the Shapers' War who got his nickname from punching out an angel during the Shapers' War. "He was once a radical, but he has more recently become aligned with the rest of the council – even voting for the Revolutionary Council's neutrality in the Falconer's Rebellion." His seat represents the Dol-Makjar districts of Silverhill, Shafira, the Rookery, and the Tanners.

In his youth, Agztash was a legendary hero of the Shapers' War who was elected to the Revolutionary Council shortly thereafter. During the War, he was hit at the edge of an area of effect by one of Azgra's spells and survived, adding to his legend. As the years went on, when asked if he was going to step down from his Council seat he responded he was still healthy and had no plans to do so. He had a "prodigious" constitution. After Azgra died, he led the charge to help the other nations that were still fighting their gods. He was hit by an arrow from a celestial designed to kill all mortals on contact, and he finished the battle and then pulled it out afterwards.

He is now 99 years old, very ill and constantly attended by his nurse, Jayan Nathir, a Candescent Creed member who heals him with the Light, keeping him alive. He was one of the three Council members to whom the Schemers sent an invitation to attend a performance of "KoTher'ai" at The Hallowed Round.
